question: Indian cricket team lost 2021 ICC World Test Championship Final to which country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Zealand.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The final of the ICC World Test Championship between **India and New Zealand** will be played in a bio-secure bubble at the Hampshire Bowl in **Southampton, England**.
 
• It started on **1 August 2019** with the first Test of the 2019 Ashes series and finished with the Final at the Rose Bowl, Southampton in **June 2021.**
 
• **New Zealand** **won** the** ICC Test Championship mace for the first time** and was also awarded the cash prize of US$1.6 million, while India won US$800,0.
 
• The Captain of New Zealand is **Kane Williamson. (As of 2023)**
 
• The *ICC World Test Championship* is an international cricket competition organized by the International Cricket Council (ICC) for the ten test cricket-playing nations. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• International Cricket Council

 
 
• It is the world governing body of cricket.
 
• It was founded as the Imperial Cricket Conference in 1909.
 
• It was founded by representatives from Australia, England, and South Africa.
 
• It was renamed the International Cricket Conference in 1965.
 
• It took its current name in 1987.
 
• Headquarters of ICC: Dubai, UAE.
